title: We are 100% paperless
description: At Focus Accountancy we no longer accept any paperwork - all accounts must be submitted online.
author: Barry Adams
html:
One of our main values, apart from our focus on excellent customer service, has always been sustainability and care for the environment. That's why we were working from home long before the Covid pandemic made it the norm, and why we have an ECO-friendly office.

We have always encouraged our clients to submit their accounts online, which is one of the reasons why we love the FreeAgent software so much.

In 2021 we're taking this one step further and we are now 100% paperless. All paperwork can be submitted electronically, so we will no longer be accepting any physical documents.

We believe that this has various benefits:

  • Better for the environment

  • Faster turnaround

  • Easy access for everyone (yet completely safe & secure)

  • No risk of virus transmission through ring binders and envelopes

  • Cost-saving for us and our clients

  • Great preparation for Making Tax Digital

Of course, accounts often contain sensitive and confidential information, which is why we have a completely safe and secure Client Portal through which all of this can be submitted.

If you have any questions about this (or would like to discuss your accounts), remember that we are always here for you. You can book a 30-minute call with Barry, or email us on team@focusaccountancy.co.uk.
